description: Consolidate ingestion and the warehouse: cut the enforcement layer while preserving the ML serving lane, key everything to one Type-2 conformed geometry dimension, port ingestion to the Python CLI, and serve past-to-future through one day-granular read path
dependency_mode: Owns DDL changes to agri (Alembic) and geo (Drizzle) on the single plantgeo database. Drizzle owns geo/public/tracking; Alembic owns agri; Python does DML only into geo. Neither tool's autogenerate is ever run against the other's schema.
activation_gate: Phases 2 and 3 make destructive agri schema changes that are free only while agri holds 0 rows; phase 4 writes the first row, so 2 and 3 must both land before 4. Every Alembic revision in phase 2 is gated on REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW agri.mv_forecast_ml_daily_serving succeeding. Production migrations are applied by the owner, never by an agent.
resolution: All plan items verified against prod 2026-08-14 (alembic 20260808_0019 live, enforcement layer gone, nine ML-serving tables intact, both UI defects fixed).
